patterns.api_view_pattern: All API views use @login_required decorator, take 'q' parameter, require 2+ chars, return JsonResponse with 'results' array
patterns.url_pattern: API endpoints use path('api/..., name='..._api') pattern
patterns.test_pattern: Tests inherit from TestCase, use setUp for fixtures, test valid queries, short queries, and auth requirements
patterns.search_pattern: Use Q() objects for OR queries, filter by is_active=True, limit to 10 results with [:10]
